description: Capability for the main window. Grants permission to execute the bundled cleanup-ui sidecar (by its registered externalBin name, sidecar-scoped, with a fixed argument list) plus Tauri's own default core permissions (window/event/webview management etc), plus three narrowly-scoped macOS commands used only by the icon-picker's Finder-icon swap: reading CFBundleIconFile out of the running .app's Info.plist (read-only), touching the .app bundle path to nudge Finder's icon cache, and an admin-prompted `osascript`/`do shell script` fallback used only when the plain filesystem copy is denied (e.g. the app is installed in /Applications). No filesystem plugin, no HTTP/network plugin, no shell access beyond these four named commands, no updater, no analytics/telemetry.
